unit.label: -fold
unit.core_meaning: increased by, or having so many parts
unit.mentor_note: Fold is multiplication written into the word. A tenfold rise is not ten more, it is ten times — and a passage that says one when it means the other is testing whether you noticed.

members.meaning: having two parts, or twice as great

predict_options.text: Multiplied by, or made of that many parts

discovery.understand_note: Fold multiplies. It also counts parts: a twofold argument has two strands. Either way it is a quantity word, and quantity words are where careless reading costs marks.

applies.prompt: A yield that increased a hundredfold went up by how much?

options.text: It became a hundred times what it was
It went up by a hundred units
It rose by a hundred per cent, that is, doubled
